assets.subject: opening_sad_scene
assets.notes: Fadyme alone in the wayshrine at night, writing the letter by one candle, a blood-marked glove, rain at the door
Brin bracing a burning beam over the woodcutters' shelter while Mahmut takes the other end

assets.subject: ch1_camp
assets.notes: night camp at the shrine; ash above the fire drifts upward; a cracked handbell rings far off
Yseldra in the flooded nave calling Fadyme's name; the company below her
Fadyme raising the bell over the poisoned well, the spell costing more than she shows
the Red Vial ward ledger open; Fadyme reading her own count
on the bridge in fog, Fadyme's hood slips and one bone-white lock shows; Mahmut does not see it
Marshal Oren alone on the bridge span, holding it, then leaving by the estate road
gallery of portraits with cut nameplates; the mother's portrait with the bell pin; the gloved attendant beside a watch with no hands
a stair through the mountain crossed by seven chains, each with a gray seven-notched seal
the companions arriving on the stair to hold the road
Mirel writing Fadyme's name back on the record while the others speak it

assets.subject: part1_emotional_confession
assets.notes: outer dais at dawn; Mahmut's confession; Fadyme's composed face finally breaking

assets.subject: part1_clockless_reveal
assets.notes: Cael revealed in the reflection of the altar; a pocket watch with no hands

assets.subject: ending
assets.notes: Fadyme looking at Cael: 'Uncle.'

assets.subject: oath_01_aveline
assets.notes: Aveline at the rainlit cathedral threshold, lantern raised to shelter pilgrims; no text baked into image.

assets.subject: oath_02_sable
assets.notes: Sable in a bridge signal tower with one cut bell-rope and fog behind her; silhouette-led, not pin-up.

assets.subject: oath_03_nara
assets.notes: Nara leads civilians across the Forsaken Bridge while holding the gate against a knight line.

assets.subject: oath_04_mirel
assets.notes: Mirel studies a missing ledger page under a brass lens in the Ashen estate archive.

assets.subject: oath_05_vespera
assets.notes: Vespera stands amid conservatory reflections aligned like a broken crown; opaque costume and glass focus visible.

assets.subject: weapon_01_last_vigil
assets.notes: A reliquary staff and sun-disc lantern held before the flooded Saint Luthos archive; warm light protects a small group of pilgrims; no text baked into image.

assets.subject: weapon_02_broken_bell
assets.notes: A pair of narrow courier blades crossed against a severed bell-rope and foggy bridge signal tower; restrained silhouette, no text baked into image.

assets.subject: weapon_03_gatewarden_promise
assets.notes: A fortress glaive and compact kite shield braced at the Forsaken Bridge gate, refugees safely behind the shield line; no text baked into image.

assets.subject: weapon_04_unwritten_ledger
assets.notes: A brass astrolabe folio and stylus dagger beside the missing ledger page under a reading lens in the Ashen estate archive; no text baked into image.

assets.notes: A glass lantern and focus ring reflected in conservatory panes aligned like a broken crown; opaque magical atmosphere, no text baked into image.
